note: An example for the layout in deploy/: Caddy on the same machine, in front of the server on 127.0.0.1:8080. Every number is an illustration of the shape, not a recommendation: README.md, Deployment, says how to pick them for your disk, members and link. The server has no defaults, so every limit shown is required. Ids come from `sunbird mint-id`, token_sha256 from `sunbird mint-token`; the tokens behind these hashes were thrown away. google_signin is optional: delete the whole section and nobody can sign in with Google; its client id and secret come from your own Google Cloud project, and a config holding the real secret must stay out of version control. 127.0.0.1 is in trusted_proxies because Caddy connects from it and sets X-Forwarded-For; list a proxy only if it sits in front of the server and does that. With none listed the header is ignored.
